issue.title: governance: repair current-master style admission for zero-legacy scanner owners
issue.body:
Parent: #1604
Blocks: #3533 standard style admission; downstream #3529/#3530 and #3525 remain separate.

## Current-master evidence

The merged #3511 zero-legacy scanner changed `tools/docs/behavior-document-consistency-final.mjs` and `tests/tools/behavior-document-consistency-final.test.mjs`. On the current master blob set (scanner 91180cedd5bbd71af674dc0fbc9c35c57fcbfdb2; test 8fd31bd09510977fd20621a43ce68520515041f7), the current style checker/policy/baseline blobs are identical to those on the #3525 comparison branch. The official `check-frontend-style.mjs --mode changed --file <both paths>` exits 1 with 1,669 diagnostic lines, starting with pre-existing missing semicolons. Neither path appears in the current frontend-style baseline. The #3533 candidate's normal changed-mode check likewise fails, so its code cannot be treated as style-accepted merely because functional tests pass.

The independent reviewed-residual authority check itself passes (149 paths, 329 parent-import diagnostics, zero other). That is not a waiver for unformatted new source or an authorization to alter the authority in a candidate.

## Scope

- Inventory the exact current-master style delta for the two scanner owner files and any directly coupled generated/style authority outputs; do not infer a repository-wide formatter task from these two files.
- Repair the current-master style admission through the existing reviewed mechanical migration/change-contract process. Keep parser/zero-legacy/DocClaim behavior and wire/public contracts unchanged; do not silence rules, add baseline debt, forge residual metadata, or mix a broad format rewrite into #3533's behavior fix.
- Rebind any exact reviewed parent-import residual only through its current owner-controlled process if required; do not let the candidate checker approve itself.

## Acceptance

- [ ] Current-master source, policy, baseline and diagnostic identities are sealed before changes; distinguish baseline defects from new #3533 regressions.
- [ ] Mechanical formatting is a separately reviewed, AST/token/comment-equivalent change with idempotence evidence, exact format-only commit classification and subsequent blame-ignore registration as required by the current change contract.
- [ ] Existing 149-path/329-diagnostic reviewed residual remains valid or is lawfully re-reviewed and rebound without adding other residuals or weakening rules.
- [ ] Changed/full style checks pass on the final candidate, alongside zero-legacy, DocClaim, release-final static boundary and generated-output fixed-point checks affected by the source rewrite.
- [ ] Standard PR independent review, merge and current-master recheck complete before #3533 counts style admission as satisfied.

This is a non-FsusUI prerequisite. It does not authorize trusted policy promotion, a self-issued exception or closure of #3533/#3525.
